title: College Roster - Lady Irwin College, Delhi
summary: College Roster - Lady Irwin College, Delhi: The webpage provides information about Lady Irwin College in Delhi, including its address, contact details, and quick links for students. It lists the college's operating hours from 9:30 am to 5:00 pm and a phone number (014836) for inquiries. The college is part of the University of Delhi, holds an A+ NAAC accreditation, and is ranked 31 in the NIRF rankings. Admission enquiries are directed to the provided contact. The page ends with a copyright notice for 2026 and a note that it is powered by WhiteCode.
key_points: Lady Irwin College is located in Delhi and is affiliated with the University of Delhi.
The college’s contact phone number is 014836 and it operates from 9:30 am to 5:00 pm.
Quick links for students are provided on the webpage.
The college holds an A+ accreditation from NAAC.
